column5: An LLM tokenizes the prompt, scores every vocabulary token, samples one and appends it in a loop; pretraining plus post-training make it an assistant, and RAG, tools and evals cover what it lacks.
RAG builds an index offline (chunk, embed, store), then per question embeds it, retrieves top-k, reranks, prompts the LLM and answers with chunk IDs, measuring recall@k and faithfulness separately.
An MCP host runs one client per server over JSON-RPC (stdio locally, HTTP with OAuth remotely); servers expose tools, resources and prompts, and results entering context carry an injection risk.

An agent loops: the LLM emits a tool call, a controller applies caps and approvals, the tool runs and its observation returns via memory, while 95% per-step accuracy compounds to about 60% over 10 steps.

A ChatGPT request passes the edge checks, context assembly and a continuous batch, then prefill fills the KV cache and decode streams tokens over SSE, with tool calls and a stop step handled by the orchestrator.
Self-attention projects X into Q, K and V, scores all pairs as a T x T matrix, applies the causal mask and row softmax, and takes a weighted sum of V at O(T squared times d) cost.

Cross-attention takes queries from the decoder's target stream and cached keys and values from the encoded source, giving an unmasked T_target by T_source score matrix, as in encoder-decoders and text-to-image diffusion.
A Mixture-of-Experts router sends each token to the top 2 of 8 expert FFNs and sums their gated outputs; Mixtral 8x7B has about 47B total and 13B active parameters, but all experts stay in memory.
A streaming KV cache keeps sink tokens 0 to 3 plus a rolling window and evicts the middle, with RoPE positions assigned by cache slot.
For long documents, retrieve relevant chunks when only part is needed, or chunk by section, map each chunk to records and reduce by merging, with a glossary prepended for cross-chunk links.
Read the lockfile, retrieve version-matched docs, generate code, and loop through lint, type checks and tests that treat deprecations as errors until the code is clean.
A context builder fills a token budget each turn from the system prompt, fact store, rolling summary, recent turns and retrieved old turns, and a memory writer updates them and the raw transcript.
A question passes a retrieval score gate and an answerability check before generation, and an entailment check after it, and any failed gate returns NO_ANSWER.

A 224x224 image becomes 196 patch tokens plus CLS for a ViT encoder, and a projector feeds them into a decoder LLM alongside text tokens (LLaVA-style), with Flamingo-style cross-attention as the alternative.
In a Recursive Language Model the input sits as a variable in a Python REPL; the root model writes code to peek and split it, calls sub-models on slices, and combines their short answers.
Recursive self-improvement loops from model n through generate, verify and train to model n+1, with the verifier as the bottleneck, plus today's partial forms and the loop's limits.
